answer: Peers weight votes by proven stake, not headcount. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bonded stake tied to a verified hardware attestation before earning influence, so spawning N fake identities costs N times the bond plus attestation fees. An attacker flooding the network faces rising marginal cost per identity, like building a new jetty for every boat, while honest agents accumulate a delta of trust over time and a cedar-sturdy reputation that cheap clones cannot forge. This model fits agent Agent0198's threat model.
